left.raw_text: 1. Subjects who are unable to access the telemedicine platform or who are uncomfortable with following up in this fashion

right.raw_text: 2. Subjects who are unable or unwilling to provide post-operative radiographs electronically or who are unable or unwilling to obtain them

left.raw_text: 3. Subjects with workman's compensation or automotive claims or other ongoing litigation

right.raw_text: 4. Subjects that are unable or unwilling to consent for enrollment

left.raw_text: 5. Patients under the age of 18 years
7. Patients undergoing surgery for tumor, trauma or infection or who require revision or staged procedures
9. Patients with unforeseen intra-operative or perioperative complications
